2607.24049.title: Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Neighborhood Search for Arrival-Departure Track Utilization Adjustment under Short-Term Disturbances
2607.24049.paper_summary: Short-term disturbances at major passenger railway stations alter train arrival and departure times as well as the release sequence of station resources. Effective recovery therefore requires coordinated adjustment of arrival-departure track allocation, station resource occupation, and train retiming. This study represents the station resources involved in train arrival, track occupancy, and departure operations as zone-level resource-occupation intervals. An arrival-departure track allocation adjustment model is formulated. Resource compatibility is imposed as the feasibility condition, while train delays and resource reassignment costs are jointly considered. A quantum-inspired evolutionary algorithm combined with neighborhood search (QEA-NS) is proposed to solve the model. Perturbation instances are constructed using GTFS timetable data from Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof, Germany. QEA-NS is compared with CP-SAT under the same candidate resource set and feasibility criteria. Both methods generate solutions satisfying the modeled resource compatibility constraints. QEA-NS yields a total delay of 388 min, compared with 519 min for CP-SAT, representing a reduction of 25.2\%. The mean delay of delayed trains decreases from 4.99 to 3.73 min, although QEA-NS requires a longer solution time. Across 10 random perturbation instances, QEA-NS achieves lower total delay in every case. Its mean total delay and standard deviation are 390.5 min and 35.945 min, respectively, compared with 673.8 min and 105.739 min for CP-SAT. The results indicate that, under the adopted resource representation and constraints, QEA-NS improves the delay performance of recovery plans. Its computational efficiency, however, requires further improvement.
2607.24049.paper_summary_zh: 短期干擾在主要客運火車站改變了列車的到達和出發時間以及車站資源的釋放順序。因此，有效的恢復需要協調調整到達-出發軌道分配、車站資源佔用和列車重新定時。本研究將列車到達、軌道佔用和出發操作中涉及的車站資源表示為區域級資源佔用區間。提出了一個到達-出發軌道分配調整模型。資源相容性被施加為可行性條件，同時考慮列車延誤和資源重新分配成本。提出了一種結合了鄰域搜索的量子啟發進化算法（QEA-NS）來解決該模型。擾動實例是使用德國法蘭克福中央車站的GTFS時刻表數據構建的。在相同的候選資源集和可行性標準下，QEA-NS與CP-SAT進行比較。這兩種方法都生成滿足建模資源相容性約束的解。QEA-NS的總延誤為388分鐘，而CP-SAT為519分鐘，減少了25.2%。雖然QEA-NS需要更長的解決時間，但延誤列車的平均延誤從4.99分鐘減少到3.73分鐘。在10個隨機擾動實例中，QEA-NS在每個案例中都實現了較低的總延誤。其平均總延誤和標準差分別為390.5分鐘和35.945分鐘，而CP-SAT為673.8分鐘和105.739分鐘。結果表明，在採用的資源表示和約束下，QEA-NS改善了恢復計劃的延誤性能。然而，其計算效率仍需進一步改進。
